## What problem would this solve?

Describe the learner or contributor need.

## Suggested change

Explain the experience you would like to see. A sketch is welcome.

## Alternatives or related work

What can people do today? Link related issues if any.

## Safety and learning content

Would this use external services, personal data, AI calls, or cybersecurity
exercises? How would it stay defensive and usable without paid services?

Please do not include credentials or private user data. For a vulnerability,
follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Zh0kz/cyberpath-ai/security/policy) instead.
